product_one_liner.value: TwelveLabs builds multimodal video AI models and APIs that help businesses and developers search, analyze, and understand video content.
product_one_liner.notes: Company homepage describes enterprise video AI for searching, analyzing, and understanding video.

pricing_page.notes: Public pricing page lists Free, Plus, Pro, and Enterprise plans and prices.

named_customers.notes: Both are identified in dedicated TwelveLabs customer case studies.

employee_band.notes: Built In lists 94 total employees, which falls in the 51-100 band. LinkedIn’s broader band is 51-200, so the narrower reported count is used.

hq_location.notes: Company profile lists San Francisco as headquarters.

eng_blog.notes: The blog includes technical posts about building Pegasus, time-based metadata, evaluation datasets/metrics and model development; there are multiple engineering-oriented posts, not just marketing.

public_docs.notes: Public developer documentation contains API references, SDK references, product guides, release notes, and numerous articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live job-board search result shows an open Research Science role; research-science titles qualify under the stated criteria.

model_provider.value: OpenAI provides LLM APIs for the reasoning layer in TwelveLabs’ agentic products; its video-understanding models are TwelveLabs’ own models.
model_provider.notes: The subprocessor list names OpenAI for LLM APIs. The model documentation describes TwelveLabs' own video models; this does not imply OpenAI supplies those video models.

compliance_certs.notes: TwelveLabs publicly states that it completed a SOC 2 Type 2 audit/certification. No other eligible certification is included.

last_funding.notes: Company announcement dated July 1, 2026, states it raised $100 million in Series B funding.

raised_18mo.notes: The July 2026 Series B falls within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current job-board result is available and lists roles, but no SDR, BDR, account executive, or qualifying sales/business development representative title is shown.

launched_6mo.notes: On October 15, 2026, TwelveLabs announced Jockey’s general availability and new capabilities, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The available company about page does not establish a C-level or VP hire/departure during the window; the verifiable named leadership additions found are older than the window. No recent departure announcement was found. Treating this as false is less conclusive than the other negative findings.

crm_stack_signal.notes: No readable job posting, integration page, or documentation source was found identifying TwelveLabs’ internal CRM or sales/marketing systems; product partner integrations do not establish its internal stack.
